concerns.text: The plan proposes a 10 000‑permutation test for the Local Non‑Additivity Index on up to 4 950 bit‑pairs (≈ 49 M correlation calculations). On the GitHub Actions free tier (2 CPU cores, 7 GB RAM) this is unlikely to complete within the stated ≤ 4 h runtime budget, making the compute requirement infeasible.
The fingerprint length constraint is stated as ≤ 2 200 bits, yet the plan generates three fingerprints (MACCS 166 bits, ECFP4 1024 bits, FP2 1024 bits) totaling 2 214 bits, exceeding the limit.
